maturityLevels.advanced: Dedicated executable contracts, negative regressions and specialist validators exist for substantial review-candidate coverage.
maturityLevels.constrained: Typed domain semantics exist, but native authoring or specialist evidence remains incomplete.
maturityLevels.foundation: Normative domain-pack recall and exact coverage exist; specialist generation/analysis must remain blocked or externally supplied.
